_meta.purpose: Curated revealed-preference events -- COSTLY ACTIONS that reveal alignment (open-market purchases, maturity extensions, subordination, senior-debt repayment) or MISalignment (dilutive refinancing, backstop withdrawal, hidden claim-count inflation). The PSIX checklist: infer alignment from costly actions, not from optimistic language. Hand-curated from filings; refresh as events are read.

PSIX._note: Power Solutions International, the May 2024 archetype. Historical/documented -- the reference assembly, not a live candidate (PSIX has since relisted to Nasdaq and re-rated ~20x).

events.desc: Weichai extended its fully-drawn $25M subordinated shareholder loan (due that day) by one year, AFTER seeing the 7 May inflection; kept its claim behind Standard Chartered.
Weichai extended ~$19.8M drawn under a $30M shareholder facility to Mar 2025.
Neil Gagnon (>10% holder) accounts bought 77,618 shares at exactly $2 (~$155k) one week before Q1 results; earlier 5,392 at $2 on Mar 20.
Repaid $5M senior bank debt in Q1 + $5M in April; interest expense already down $4.7M->$3.3M YoY.
Weichai executive Kui Jiang appointed to board -- active oversight, not minority protection.
$130M Weichai backstop of the senior facility expired and was NOT renewed -- but the SC facility had shrunk $130M->$50M, so partly redundant.

Refinanced via large PIPE + preferred exchange; ~82.6M shares now issued vs stale ~50M feeds. Closest PSIX pattern but FAILS the original price test after dilution -- pro-forma EV ~$507M ~= 8-9x EBITDA guide, nowhere near May-2024 PSIX.
Deleveraging + data-center wins; 2026 adj EBITDA guide $55-65M.
